title: logos Shelf-B prelude manifest
description: ADR 0016 Shelf B — the hash-pinned Horn-clause prelude. A `prelude/<name>@<version>.json` bundle is an array of account clauses plus a pinned `program_digest`. The bundle is CURATED DATA, not a crate: its clauses are ordinary `Rule | Builtin | Leaf` derivations the EXISTING shared check() verifies (zero new trusted code). A loader (contract/rs/src/prelude.rs::load_prelude) RECOMPUTES the `program_digest` over the deserialized clauses via the frozen account codec and REFUSES a mismatch. Term/goal/body-literal notation matches vectors/account.json.

version.description: Semantic version (the `<version>`). Shelf B is byte-frozen per (name@version): a published bundle is immutable; any change ships a new version.

program_digest.description: Lowercase-hex SHA-256(PROGRAM_PREFIX 'logos/account/program/v1\n' || concat of length-prefixed, byte-SORTED ontos-codec(quote(clause-as-term)) per clause). The load-bearing tamper anchor: a loader recomputes this over the deserialized clauses and rejects any mismatch. Byte-identical across {rs,go,ts} (frozen ontos-codec + syntactic VarId).

note.description: Optional human-readable description of the bundle (ignored by the loader).

clauses.description: The bundle's clauses, in manifest order. Must be non-empty and free of duplicate canonical clause ids.

id.description: Optional. The clause's canonical ClauseId = lowercase-hex SHA-256(CLAUSE_PREFIX 'logos/account/clause/v1\n' || ontos-codec(quote(clause-as-term))). When present it MUST equal the recomputed canonical id; a mismatch is rejected.

clause.description: A Horn clause `head :- body0, ..., bodyN`. An absent or empty `body` is a rule-fact.

goal.description: A predicate application p(args...). Reads as the labeled compound Tuple[Atom(pred), args...].

bodyLit.description: A body literal: a positive goal, or a negated `{ "neg": <goal> }` (ADR 0007). A positive literal reads byte-identically to the bare goal; a negated one reads as Tuple[Atom(0x00), goal-as-term].

term.description: An account term: a bare Atom (by hex `atom` or utf8 `atom_str`), a Tuple of child terms, or a Var by id. Exactly one key is present.

atom.description: A bare Atom of these hex-decoded bytes.

atom_str.description: A bare Atom of these UTF-8 bytes (a convenience spelling of `atom`).

tuple.description: A Tuple of the child terms (may contain Vars at any depth).

var.description: A variable hole, identified by name (syntactic: names are part of the encoding, no alpha-normalization).
